description: The chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models before and after introspection training. The horizontal axis contains two categories: "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini", while the vertical axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 in intervals of 0.25. Each category is represented by a grouped bar chart, with three bars corresponding to "Control", "Before Introspection Training", and "After Introspection Training", colored gray, light blue, and purple, respectively. For both models, the "Control" bar has a value close to 0, while the "Before Introspection Training" bars have values of approximately 0.50. The "After Introspection Training" bars have higher values, around 0.75, indicating an increase in self-report accuracy. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, but the error bars representing 95% HDIs are visible for each bar, indicating the uncertainty associated with the measurements. The chart effectively compares the performance of the two models under different conditions.
